rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when the manner is physically close, airless, or poorly ventilated.

example.english: The room had no windows open, and we sat stuffily inside, soon sweating all over.
example.traditional: 間房冇開窗，焗促咁坐喺入面一陣，已經成身汗。
example.jyutping: gaan1 fong4 mou5 hoi1 coeng1 guk6 cuk1 gam3 co5 hai2 jap6 min6 jat1 zan6 ji5 ging1 seng4 san1 hon6

rows.note: Use this when the stuffiness comes from an overly serious, pompous, and dull presentation.

example.english: They spoke stuffily for a whole hour, and I nearly fell asleep.
example.traditional: 佢一本正經咁講咗成個鐘，悶到我差啲瞓着。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 bun2 zing3 ging1 gam3 gong2 zo2 seng4 go3 zung1 mun6 dou3 ngo5 caa1 di1 fan3 zoek6
